reviews.text: Doctor McGee and his assistant, Katelyn, were here today to perform euthanasia for my cat.  They were very comforting during a hard time.  They spent the time to make the process as easy as possible for my cat and I greatly appreciate that.

I cannot recommend Dr. McGee enough. I called around 2 p.m. during one of the hardest days a pet owner can face, and he made time to come to our home that same evening.

From the moment he arrived, Dr. McGee was incredibly gentle, kind, and empathetic. He was calm and patient, and he thoroughly explained what to expect every step of the way, which brought us comfort during such a heartbreaking moment.

It takes a very special kind of person to do this work with the compassion that Dr. McGee showed our family. Most importantly, he treated our dog Lala with such tenderness. He made sure she was comfortable, showed her love, and allowed her to leave this world peacefully and with dignity in the comfort of her own home.

We will always be grateful for the kindness he showed her and our family during her final hour. If you ever find yourself needing this type of care for a beloved pet, I highly recommend Dr. McGee.
❤️🐾 🌈 🪽
Service was fair, efficient, respectful and kind. As we returned our dog to God.

We had such a wonderful experience with Dr. McGee mobile vet. It was so convenient and comforting to have the vet come right to our home and care for our dog in a familiar, stress-free environment. They were kind, compassionate, and professional, and they took the time to explain everything clearly. Our dog was treated with such gentle, loving care. I truly appreciate the personalized attention and the convenience of having a vet come right to our door. I highly recommend this mobile vet to anyone looking for excellent care for their pets.

I was a vet tech for 20 years. I can absoultely recommend Dr. McGhee and his staff for in home veterinary care. Dr. McGhee was extremely competent, professional and kind, and his tech was amazing with both of my 100 pound labs. They did not try to offer any services I did not need, and my dogs were very comfortable with them both.  So happy with the entire experience!

Dr. McGee and Katelyn provided such compassionate, gentle care for my cat for an in-home euthanasia. They made an incredibly difficult experience feel peaceful and comfortable, and I’m so grateful they were there for us during such a heartbreaking time.

Mr McGee came into my apartment examined my dog.  Thought the peeing at night could be bladder or Cushings disease.  He suggested blood work for diabetes, and a few other.  He was also suppose to express my dogs anal glands.  He made discussing the bill a nightmare.  I tried to explain to him just give me a detailed report and bill and I’ll submit it to my ASPCA INSURANCE.  I told him I would not use him again and then he refused to treat my dog.  Also I shared with him that vets in the area, won’t work with  me simply because I’m very careful with my dog. I don’t like her to be put under, and there are many things that happened there with people were rude to me he then proceeded on his way up to say I’m not surprised because you’ve had trouble with a lot of vets,  He was Rude and dysfunctional I’m sorry to say I don’t recommend him. The girl that was with him was lovely but he is a nightmare thank you.
we are so lucky to find Dr McGee! Amazing vet. So caring, compassionate and knowledgeable!

The team was so kind and professional. My puppy of 16 years needed end-of-life services and it was the best decision to have her go peacefully in our home. They handled her with care and treated my family and I with grace and respect. It made a difficult day just a little less stressful.
Dr. McGee… thank you. Undoubtedly, this was the hardest day of our lives and Dr. McGee provided comfort, clarity and peace for our sweet boy. We will be forever grateful.

There’s not enough stars to add for McGee’s services. They were the calming energy and love we needed in a sad and stressful situation. We were put to ease and he took his time as he transitioned our beloved pup over the rainbow bridge. Much respect and love to all involved in this business. Couldn’t recommend enough.

I had such a wonderful experience with Dr. McGee and his team! He is incredibly responsive, caring, and patient. He took the time to let my cat feel comfortable rather than rushing the process, gradually easing into getting close to her and making the experience as stress-free as possible.

It’s clear that Dr. McGee and his technicians genuinely care about animals and have an incredible depth of knowledge. I really appreciate the time, compassion, and expertise they showed toward my cat.

I will definitely continue using McGee Vet for both of my cats moving forward. I highly recommend them to anyone looking for a veterinary team that truly cares about their patients! ❤️🐾

Top Professional,Compassionate care was given. The Dr and assistant were reassuring that all they performed would be in the utmost respect for the procedure. They made the family feel at ease and confident that she would be in the best care

I would like to personally thank Dr. McGee for the exceptional service he provided during a very difficult time. I had to say goodbye to my dog, which brought on a flood of emotions, stress, anxiety, and worry about my dog’s suffering. I knew it was time to let him go.

I was unsure of what to expect from an at home euthanasia for my German Shepherd, but I am so grateful to have found Dr. McGee. His compassion, sympathy, and empathy made the process much easier for my daughter and me. He explained everything step by step with professionalism and kindness.

Even though it was a heartbreaking day, Dr. McGee truly made the experience smoother. I will always recommend him to anyone who needs this service for their pet, as he is clearly in the right profession and made a significant impact on us. I will never forget the wonderful care he provided on such a difficult day. Thank you.

Dr. McGee has started taking care of our 9 year old Great Dane, Hattie. He's come to the house twice now and will do so every couple weeks to provide Hattie's treatment. At 170 pounds with weakening rear legs, getting Hattie in and out of the SUV for frequent vet visits was getting to be too difficult for her. Our Vet recommended Dr. McGee and I'm so grateful. He spends a lot of time with us, ensuring all our questions are answered. He is patient and appropriately playful with her.  She can be really anxious but she loves him!  We realize our time with Hattie is somewhat limited. Dr. McGee will be here to help her cross when the time comes.

I highly recommend Dr. McGee and trust me, as a dog momma of 6 (Hattie is the last for now), I am very particular about how my dogs are cared for.

Dr. Geoffrey McGee was extremely compassionate and responded immediately to our call early Sunday morning. He arrived within an hour of our call. He was calm, confident & informative and helped our beloved 12 year old boxer cross over the rainbow bridge. Dr. McGee interacted with our other animals as soon as he walked in the door and explained step by step how the process would happen. Our hearts are broken into pieces, but being able to help our furry family member leave us without any fear or pain was a priceless gift.  We will be using McGee veterinary services for all of our future pet medical needs, and leaving the veterinary pet chain we currently use. Thank You Dr. McGee 💛

Many thanks to Dr. McGee for making this difficult day a little more easier.  McGee and Katlyn were extremely professional and very caring. My sweet dog Buddha needed to be put down and I’m am glad I called McGee.  I would recommend him for all of your pets needs and care.

Dr. McGee in home vet is a life changer - no anxiety for my bulldog - he cares - listens and has plan to a healthy recovery!!!!
Dr. McGee & Alexis THANK YOU
Dr. McGee was wonderful! He was very professional and very kind and gentle with my pet. I was very impressed.

I never write reviews this long, but I felt so compelled to after the experience we had with Dr. McGee and his assistant Katelyn in May. This man is truly an angel in veterinarian form and I could not recommend him more. There’s a reason he has all 5-star reviews on Yelp and Google

We had to put down our 20-year-old cat Mary, who had kidney disease and pancreatic cancer much sooner than expected. She started declining rapidly late at night and we thought we might have to take her to emergency, but we wanted her to pass peacefully at home in her favorite spot on the couch. We hadn’t planned anything yet because everything happened so much faster than we expected.

I reached out to over a dozen places after hours, and Dr. McGee responded to me almost immediately. Katelyn helped coordinate everything and was equally warm, patient, and kind.

Dr. McGee and Katelyn treated Mary with so much dignity, gentleness, and love. They never made our family feel rushed and explained everything so compassionately. The entire process was peaceful despite how heartbreaking it was. They gave us the time to cry, love on her, and say goodbye.

Afterward, I found out my neighbor had also used Dr. McGee for her pet care needs and had an amazing experience. She spoke so highly of him too, which just confirmed even more how special he is.

Thank you Dr. McGee and Katelyn for giving Mary girl such a peaceful and dignified goodbye. We will never forget your kindness.

Super professional and very respectful!

Today was a very sad day for our family. We had to let our Lucy go after 15 years. Dr. McGee was very patient and caring throughout the entire process. He and Katelyn came to our home and helped us through this difficult process.

I highly recommend Dr. McGee and his team.

Dr. McGee was absolutely amazing and so kind. Him and his staff gave us all the time we needed with our sweet girl when she was passing. I can not recommend them enough and I want to thank them for their kindness and gentleness. They went above and beyond to make the time to come even as he was preparing to take his family on vacation. We didn’t think it would be so hard to find someone to help with the passing of our girl, but when I spoke to Dr. McGee he said “I will make myself available” and I can’t stress how much that ment to us in this painful time. Thank you Dr. McGee and staff!

Making this decision was one of the hardest things our family has ever had to do. Dr. McGee and his assistant were incredibly kind, patient, and compassionate as we said goodbye to our beloved 16-year-old dog. They gave us all the time we needed and made such a heartbreaking moment as peaceful and comforting as possible. We are truly grateful for the care, dignity, and respect they showed our family and our sweet girl. I couldn't have asked for a better experience during such a difficult time.

What started as they were the first vet clinic to pick up the phone quickly turned into a very kind and comforting experience.  We had to say goodbye to our cat Olivia today and when they showed up I immediately knew I made the right choice.

The let us hold her while they got her ready. They let us keep the light in the room low for her comfort. They gave kind words to both us and our pet.

They have one of the hardest jobs in the world and they do it all with consideration to dignity and the pain our family was experiencing.

If your beloved pet is telling you it's time to say goodbye , use McGee mobile vet services.

I called Dr McGee and he answered right away. I asked if he could do a same day pet euthenasia as our sweet old kitty had got to a point of no return. He squeezed us in with a few hours, was understanding, gentle, and took all the time we needed to say goodbye to our dear Bitsy. Highly recommend if you need this type of service.

These folks are absolutely life savers, literally. They came to our home and were able to treat our cat without the ordeal of putting him in a carrier and forcing him into a strange place. Our cat was treated and was able to make himself comfortable right here in our home. I highly recommend McGee to any pet owner!!!

Thank you for your review. Losing a cherished family member after 17 wonderful years is never easy, and handling it on an emergency basis is doubly hard. We are thankful we could help bring comfort and peace to Charlie's final moments. Our hearts go out to you.
Very nice and polite

Dr McGee is the best. He travels to your home to treat your pets. He is extremely thorough and knowledgeable. He goes above and beyond to learn your pets history and how he can help. I am so grateful for his service!!

​A Beacon of Kindness in Our Darkest Moment

I cannot recommend Dr. Geoff McGee and McGee Mobile Vet Service highly enough. Today, he came to our home to help our beloved dog, Bobo, cross the rainbow bridge. During a time when our family was dealing with so much heartache, Dr. McGee was an absolute blessing.
​He arrived right on time, bringing a sense of calm, patience, and deep compassion into our home. He never rushed us, explaining everything with so much gentleness and making sure Bobo was completely comfortable, peaceful, and safe every single step of the way.
​What truly touched our hearts was how wonderful he was with my granddaughter. He took the extra time and care to help her create five beautiful paw prints—one for each of the kids to hold onto. It was an incredibly thoughtful gesture that we will treasure forever.
​Dr. McGee’s exceptional care, kindness, and professionalism during such a painful day completely won us over. We have already decided that he will be our permanent family veterinarian for all of our animals across our three different households. If you want a vet who truly cares about both the animals and the families who love them, look no further than Dr. McGee.

Dr McGee and his assistant, Alexis are the best!   My puppies were actually calm and enjoyed their Dr visit today.   Dr McGee performed a more complete exam than they ever had and explained everything in an easy to understand way.  I would highly suggest Dr McGee’s mobile clinic especially for vet nervous pets.  Pricing is very responsible especially with the fact that he is making a house call.  I have definitely found my puppies forever vet.
Dr McGee was exceptional when he made our difficult time less stressful . Compassion and taking his time was so appreciated. I can’t thank him enough ! Highly recommend his service!
He arrived quickly same day and was very thorough and honest. Highly recommend.

If I could give them 10 starts plus I would . I had to put my beautiful Great Dane down named Rhuburt this past Monday . This by far was the best experience I could have had at a time like that .
I did call around a few places and no one could do a in-house euthanasia for my sweet boy same day. Dr McGee got us in and was very caring and professional. He came in to our home and treat us and my dogs like family . I couldn’t have asked for a better person to help us at such an awful time . I will be continuing to use him and recommending him out to everyone I know . I’m blessed for the kindness and caring he provided us.  His team was also AMAZING and handled with care . Thank you so much for going above and beyond.

There are not enough stars to rate the service received from this Veterinary Doctor.  He was empathetic, genuine and a true love for animals was obvious throughout the time he spent caring for my animals. Over the years, i have tried numerous different animal clinics and emergency vets in the Phoenix area. I won't be calling any other in the future.  Dr. McGee is young but he is good! He saved my cats life (and hind leg) and his final invoice was much lower than i was anticipating.  I cannot express my gratitude enough -- Thank you Dr. McGee!

We had Dr. McGee and Katelyn at our home today for an exam on 3 of our cats and lab work for one. It was an excellent experience. Dr. McGee was very patient and flexible, spent time to connect with our cats and educate us on findings. It was  less stressful for us and the cats to have an in home visit. It was a great experience and I highly recommend his services.

I'm confined to a wheelchair my large breed dog turned on me after a long illness I was trapped in my apartment I called everyone no one would come I came across the McGee that services they came right away my dog had to be put down they did it with compassion and care they're not just vets they're superheroes I'm a cat person now I plan to use them in the future

I live in Florida.  My brother who is disabled and cannot walk and is confined to a wheelchair., lives Phoenix.  My brother has had this service dog for several years and the dog has worked out ok for him. However, Recently the dog began being aggressive and 6 days previous to Dr McGee’s visit the dog had attacked my brother. For 6 days my brother could only leave the dog long enough to go to restroom. Dog had bit him in the face and on the hands and became aggressive when my brother left his wheelchair for bathroom visits.  Calls were made to numerous agencies to come to pick up the dog - police, animal control,  his vet and other vets (most wanted at least $2,000 or more to come)and numerous other vets and people. I personally had 5 pages of numbers I had called to get help and my brother had numerous pages of numbers he had called for help.  Bottom line, this dog held him hostage for 6 days! My brother was at his wits end, totally exhausted. He could get NO HELP!!
Dr McGee came to his rescue!  He was a God-send!  My brother said Dr McGee was gentle with this snarling dog and took his time getting this difficult euthanasia completed which made this dangerous and sad event more tolerable.
I have never met Dr McGee but my brother told me everything.  Plus Dr McGee’s price was in keeping with my brothers income.
I cannot say enough positive words to express my gratitude for such competence and caring for this wonderful veterinarian.

Dr. McGee is an amazing veterinarian, and I can’t recommend him enough. He is incredibly caring and takes the time to truly understand both you and your pets, learning their personalities and what makes them comfortable. That level of attention makes a huge difference.

Having Dr. McGee and his team come directly to your home is honestly priceless. It creates such a calm, familiar environment for your pets, which completely changes the experience.

I live in the DC Ranch/North Scottsdale area, and I strongly recommend him to anyone nearby. My dogs, Ace and Caddy, absolutely love him. They used to get anxious about vet visits, but now they get excited when he shows up; even when they might be getting shots.
Dr. MCGee was on time, great communication and took the time to explain everything to me about my dogs. It was so nice that he came to my home as well. Great experience.

Dr McGee was so kind and compassionate with both our dog and us when it was time to assist our beloved pup over the rainbow bridge. He arrived on time and was so thoughtful of our feelings and grief.  He was kind and gentle with our dog, always keeping him quiet and calm.  It was a very gentle passing. Our other dog was lying with us when his brother passed.

We were incredibly impressed with Dr. McGee. He was so gentle with our senior cat and took the time to let her get comfortable with him. His calm, patient demeanor made a huge difference, and it was clear he truly cares. He’s professional, extremely knowledgeable about senior cats, follows a thoughtful “do no harm” philosophy, and is genuinely kind. His veterinary technician, Katelyn, was just as wonderful and helped keep our kitty relaxed throughout the visit. They were both so sweet with her.

We had been taking our cat elsewhere for monthly Solensia injections, but the process had become very stressful for her—getting her into the carrier, the drive, and the busy clinic environment were all overwhelming. Our last visit was upsetting; the staff didn’t seem very gentle with our old gal. That experience pushed us to look for a better option. After reading the reviews for Dr. McGee, we decided to make a change, and we’re so glad we did. I highly recommend McGee Veterinary Service.

Absolutely outstanding care! Dr. McGee was very compassionate and gentle with our beloved little girl. He was incredibly informative, answering every question and making sure we understood the plan.  One can tell he genuinely cares. The convenience of having care at home made a big difference and we felt truly supported the whole time.  We are very grateful and would recommend him without hesitation.

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating! The team at McGee Vet Service is always happy to provide top-tier mobile vet care to the pets of Phoenix and Scottsdale. We appreciate your support and look forward to seeing you and your furry family member again soon for your next at-home pet exam!

On two separate visits for my two dogs, Dr. McGee and his assistant sat on the floor with each dog and let each dog take her & his own time to get to know and be comfortable with the Dr. & the tech.  I really liked that!  I have had other mobile vets come before and they never took that time for my dogs to be comfortable nor to get to know each dog, so I'm very impressed!  And my dogs actually liked them compared to the doctors at other vet clinics and the other mobile vets I've seen.
Dr. McGee actually heard a heart murmur in one dog that the other vets had missed or failed to tell me about. The doctor's interactions with my dogs before, during and after the exams was phenomenal and I'm so happy I finally found a great vet!!!  I also want to mention that Dr. McGee hasn't and won't sell out to a corporation like many of the vets are doing, which is one reason I left the last vet I saw!
I want to shout a giant THANK YOU to Dr. McGee and his techs! Oh, I almost forgot to say too that every time I had called, the person answering the phone was super nice, patient with me and listened to my concerns which eased my anxiety--extremely helpful.  Thank you!

Dr. McGee and his team were incredibly compassionate and professional during one of the most difficult moments for our family. This was our first interaction with his practice, and the staff member on the phone was patient and kind in answering my many questions.

Dr. McGee came to our home and was exceptionally gentle and patient. He took the time needed for our two reactive dogs to feel calm and comfortable, answered all of our questions, and never rushed the process. He gave us the space and time we needed to say goodbye to our Stella before completing the procedure.

We are deeply grateful for the care and compassion shown to our family and would highly recommend Dr. McGee.

Our beloved dog, Harley, died on New Year’s Day.  Dr. McGee responded to my request for help with his remains immediately.   He was kind and compassionate and showed great respect for our loss and the processes that follow the death of a pet.  He was wonderful with our remaining dog, a Cane Corso whose growl can be scary.  He understood that she was frightened and anxious with grief.  I highly recommend him for his compassion and expertise, and the costs were not unreasonable.

Dr McGee is absolutely amazing and so caring! We have a 12 year old dog who has extreme anxiety at the vet to where she will have a seizure from stress. He took his time with her and throughly went over everything with us and refilled her medications (which were also cheaper with him). It was so nice to have the time to talk and ask questions without feeling rushed and not have to worry about our dog getting overly stressed out. Highly recommend!
Dr McGee came to our house and handled our elderly dog with the same care he would his own dog. He and his team were professional and honest. We'll use them again.

Sincerely the best Vet I have ever had. My cat does not travel well and when we need care, Dr. McGee is available within a day. He remembers all of the 4 pets in my house and treats them with incredible kindness. 10/5 stars, Dr. McGee will be always my first call.

Dr McGee was very loving and patient with our Great Dane she was ill and ready to cross the rainbow bridge and he helped give her dignity and comfort while doing this at home surrounded by her humans highly recommend his services thank you for making our Sassy feel safe and comfortable as she passed and for allowing us our time with her
The Hennings

Highly recommend Dr. McGee!  We found him when we needed to address a cat emergency at home while we were out of town.  Dr. McGee showed up in short order, spent considerable time making sure kitty was comfortable with him, did a thorough exam, diagnosed the issue and recommended follow up. This cat is SO wild at the vet that he has not been examined in years, the regular vet can't even get him out of the carrier.  Totally different scenario when Dr. McGee comes to the house.
Dr. McGee just visited again to address kitty's chronic condition with equally positive results. This time, I learned that if you book far enough in advance, the visit is no more costly than going to a vet.  I liked that he offers various modes of treatment, can explain the research, the potential downsides, etc.  He will be our regular vet going forward.

Dr. McGee and his team are phenomenal!  From scheduling to the in-home visit, everything went smoothly and was super efficient. I appreciate the thorough exam of my senior dog and the clear care and compassion this team has for animals. They were gentle, kind, and so patient with my old girl. Thank you!

Included pic of the patient for dog tax. ☺️

De. McGee and his assistant are amazing very compassionate, friendly and professional. He got out to us way out in surprise as quickly as he good and they did everything they could to help us out with our dog. Thank you guys so much.

We had an absolutely wonderful experience with McGee Veterinary Service. I needed to urgently coordinate out of-state, in home euthanasia services for an elderly family member’s beloved pet, and they were the only team able to accommodate us the very same day. Their compassion and flexibility were exceptional. They worked with us on timing, payment, care coordination, and even personally delivered our sweet girl back to us afterward.

Dr. McGee and the entire staff showed genuine kindness during an incredibly difficult moment, and we are deeply grateful for their support. We wholeheartedly recommend McGee Veterinary Service for any veterinary needs.

Their care truly goes above and beyond!

Dr McGee provided the most wonderful and thoughtful care for our elderly dog. His office made scheduling very easy. From the first moment we contacted them the level of care and compassion has been unlike any other vet we’ve encountered. Dr McGee truly goes above and beyond for his patients. We would highly recommend him to everyone.

We HIGHLY recommend McGee Mobile Vet. We have a feral indoor cat that we suspected had ring worm. They were VERY calm...professional..kind and very sympathetic. We will most definitely be using McGee vet service.

Dr. McGee was the person I needed on a day that I wish had never come. I had the doctor put my best friend down, and that is never easy. Dr. McGee understood the pain I was going through, and that helped. The world needs the services you provide for our best friends, so thank you.

We can't say enough about the wonderful experience we had with Dr. McGee.  It was our fist time having a vet come to the house for our cats' annual check ups.  The compassion and patience was evident with how he treated our treasured family members.  He even made it less stressful, sitting on the floor to perform the exam.  We received thorough details about our cat's IBD and how to feed and care for him. We recommend his services wholeheartedly.

Thank you so much for the 5-star rating Jack! We truly appreciate you taking the time to share your support. 

The entire team at McGee Veterinary Service is thrilled to see your positive feedback. We are committed to delivering the best mobile veterinary care and pet health services right to your door in the Phoenix area. 

Your high rating means the world to us and helps other pet owners find the convenient care they need. We look forward to seeing you and your pet again!

Can't recommend Geoff and his team enough. Got to know them through the chamber of commerce. They provide excellent mobile vet services throughout Phoenix. Extremely knowledgable and caring for dog and cat needs.

Dr. McGee and Rhiannon were just fantastic. They were on time, they put us at ease instantly and weren't pushy about extra tests. Dr. McGee was very patient and understood our concerns and questions. It's been eons since we had a regular vet, and we've finally found one. It's a blessing to not have to cram my poor old 13 year old cat into his carrier and take him for a ride. I couldn't be more pleased.

Dr. McGee & his staff are PHENOMENAL! Punctual, responsive, and incredibly gentle with our 2 cat babies. It was such a relief having the appointment in our home (vs. driving to the vet & having to deal with the stress that causes pets, as well as exposure to other potentially ill or aggressive animals). I highly recommend this team!
Both Dr. McGee and Kara did an awesome job giving shots to my little diva of a chihuahua mix. I would recommend him to anyone!!!

We feel so blessed to have Dr. McGee come to put our sweet, old Rottweiler down in the comfort of our home surrounded by family a few years back, but the team has been making house calls for routine vaccinations and wellness checks.  Such an amazing and convenient experience since getting our newest fur baby 3 years ago.
Dr McGee is very caring and compassionate with our Greyhound. He comes to our home and is available when needed. Highly recommend!

My almost 15 year old dog has long struggled with going to the vet. He had a surgery several years ago and since then, the vet became an extremely traumatic experience, that rarely felt worth it. As a result, he wasn't getting the care the needed. Vet care has become increasingly expensive, as all things have, but the experience for the cost was feeling very unbalanced. When I met Dr. McGee, I felt that he understood what I meant by this. Our first in-home was fantastic. He spent time getting to know my dogs, he asked great questions and really listened as I talked about years and years of history. He gave my dog breaks during exam and treatment, which made all the difference in how my dog responded. Nothing felt rushed or missed. Dr. McGee brought everything we could possibly need with him! He even had fancier exam tools than I've seen at the clinic and he took samples for testing! He reached out later that same day with testing updates, and followed up the next morning to see how my dog was doing. Yes, you pay a travel fee for the service, but all the other charges were either similar or cheaper than the vet clinic. And in my opinion, the travel fee was well worth it for the quality of care and ease on my dog. I will never return to the vet clinic.

Dr. McGee came on a very last minute call over the weekend as my dog had an ear infection. He is a puppy and I’m fairly new to area so didn’t know who or where to take my dog on a weekend. Dr. McGee came to our home making it a great experience for Churro, was patient as he is a puppy, examined him, gave him medication & was on his way all within an hour. Extremely friendly, knowledgeable and even took a look at my dogs recent neuter sight as we’ve struggled with him staying away from it. Pricing was comparable to a clinic and we will be using Dr. McGee again for future vet services. We highly recommend his services! Thank you Dr. McGee for helping Churro get back to his puppy self!

So thankful I saw a recommendation for Dr. McGee and was able to have him come to my house.  My elderly cat is traumatized when having to go to the vet and everything about the experience with Dr. McGee was calm and comforting for both my cat and I.  The appointment was thorough, all of my questions were answered, and I felt very reassured that my cat was getting quality care.  Strongly recommend!

I had a fantastic experience with this mobile veterinary service! The vet was professional, compassionate, and truly cared for my pet. Having them come to my home made the entire process stress-free. Highly recommend their first rate service!
Amazing service! came right to my home, very caring and professional. Geoff is awesome and glad to have found a service that’s so great to trust with your dogs care!

Dr. McGee and Vic are the best!!! My bulldog does awful going to the vet she gets inflamed and anxious so we wanted to try something different. Dr. McGee got us in immediately and helped my bulldog with her hotspots and some other flare ups he found during her check up, very thorough, honest and great work!! Will be calling again in the future! Cannot thank them enough for their help and service!

I'm glad I met Dr Mcgee. He is the perfect fit for our dogs. Having someone who is knowledgeable and really cares come directly to our house to help makes a big difference. He and Vic make a great team and I would highly recommend giving him a call if you want to get top notch care for your pets at home!
Well-knowledged, extraordinary customer service/relations, ESPECIALLY with canines with unique personalities and ages

Highly recommended Dr. McGee and Vic! We have a rescue ranch for horses, cats and dogs and they were able to come help multiple animals on one visit! It helps us so much to be able to do what we do for the animals! They were professional and listened to all our concerns and took time with each animal. We plan on using them for all our rescue cats and dogs! So grateful to have found them and their services!

I had the absolute best experience with. From start to finish, they provided exceptional care for my dog, Patch, ensuring he was comfortable and stress-free in the familiarity of his own home.

The vet and his team were not only professional but also incredibly compassionate, taking the time to make my dog feel at ease during the entire visit. The convenience of having such high-quality care brought directly to us made the process seamless and far less stressful for both my pet and me.

I truly appreciate the personalized attention and the way they prioritized my dog’s well-being above all else. I highly recommend them to anyone seeking top-notch, convenient, and empathetic veterinary care.
Very patient, friendly and knowledgeable
